notes: Golden Gate Park round the Stadium, Spreckels Lake and Metson Lake: park drives drawn as two lines through open land, the street bounding the park on the east (x 1533-1562) and one row of empty-outlined blocks beyond it (x 1562-1644; box stops short of the lot line at x 1647 in block 1670). Drives and paths are street; each piece of park land enclosed by drives has its own open seed. How the strokes were made: most drive lines here are dashed, so every open piece is closed by a stroke loop on the inner edge of its printed lines (the piece's paper sealed by growing the ink 3-6 px to close dash gaps, its outline grown back onto the line); where that cut a tip or bulged, the line was traced instead between eye-picked points along the ink (A at 620-660,3100-3250; B apex 658-698,3090-3230; the triangle 680-718,2860-3004; Metson Lake's shore). All checked by eye at 3-10x. Judgment calls for the owner: (1) Stadium: the field (1060,3060) is open; every ring between its oval lines (at the bottom y 3141/3154/3186/3205/3212) is street as a way round (running/cycle track, paths); the 19 px ring between the 3rd and 4th lines (3186-3205 at the bottom) may be a bank or stands rather than a way. (2) Spreckels Lake: the water (1430,2920) is open, LAKE lettering inside it; the ~8 px band between its bold outer shore line and the thin inner line (e.g. 1358-1368 at y 2850, 1458-1468 at y 2900) is left street, read as a path round the lake. (3) Metson Lake: water inside the wavy shore line (885,3403) is open, lettering inside it; the bands between that shore and the double dashed rim round it are street (paths). The teardrop (950,3435) and the small triangle (905,3428) at its SE end are open islands. (4) A small square outline (1185-1197,2837-2852), a building or kiosk, is open; a stroke closes its open corner (1184-1187,2837-2844). (5) Grass wedges between a drive and a path are open: (1335,3330) between x 1323-1347, y 3228-3470; (1480,2870) east of Spreckels Lake. The strip between the east path and the park's edge (1500-1533, 2816-3225) is open. (6) Narrow pairs of lines 5-8 px apart (paths: e.g. 655-985,3240-3795; 1050-1060,3460-3840; 1205-1225,3330-3590; 1475-1490,3010-3225; the 1-4 dashed lines in the bundle at 1168-1210,3600-3840) are street. A narrow two-line island with a closed top (1177-1205,3722-3840) and a small island at the junction (1355-1362,3195-3225) are left street (too narrow to be land worth a seed). (7) The lower line of the bottom drive stops at (905,3811), 80 px short of the drive it meets; a stroke closes it to the hook at (984,3816) and the land below (800-990,3790-3840) is open. (8) Left street: the sliver of open land above the top-left drive at the box corner (620-655,2816-2826), and a few px at the sharpest tips of open wedges where the loop cuts across (e.g. 1340-1348,3425-3470).
